source_refs.title: Find the model number of your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch - Apple Support
source_refs.applicability: iPhone; the page states no version limit for this method
source_refs.verified_excerpt: To find the model number, tap the part number.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Open the Settings app, then tap General. 2. Tap About. 3. To the right of Model Number, you'll see a part number. 4. Tap the part number to display the model number.

source_refs.title: Find the model number of your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Method 3: SIM tray (iPhone 8 or later with a SIM tray)
source_refs.applicability: iPhone 8 or later with a SIM tray
source_refs.verified_excerpt: remove the SIM tray and look in the slot.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone 8 or later with a SIM tray: 1. Remove the SIM tray and look in the slot. 2. Make sure that you're in a place with bright light overhead. 3. The model number is on the upper side, which is the side with the display.
